audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 and 5 of both charts give the stage to Swain (3/10), but the packet chart marks both Skill and the prose agrees: whys[0] says 'at level 1 he just pokes, so sidestep it and last-hit', and whys[4] says outright 'stay even by poking and backing off'. Separately the matchup is labelled TRICKY at 7.5/10 while the packet reports 55.26% over 666 games and the corrected chart gives Gangplank four of seven stages.
audit.why: Swain has no kill pressure at level 1 — Nevermove is his only setup and it is slow and two-stage — and level 6 is a mutual stand-off rather than his stage, because Demonic Ascension only wins fights Gangplank chooses to stay in.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 5 set to Skill at 5/10 in both layers; matchup re-rated EVEN at 5.5/10 to match a 55.26% win rate.

audit.why: Spikes name the right windows: Swain's Nevermove setup levels 1-3, Demonic Ascension at 6, Gangplank's Sheen keg-chain flip, and the late chained-keg burst on a squishy drain-mage. Four entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer tracks Demonic Ascension as the matchup-defining cooldown and never names Nevermove, which is the ability that actually starts every Swain combo. It also never states the two facts that decide the lane: Nevermove roots on the RETURN wave, not the outgoing one, and Remove Scurvy cures that root outright.
audit.why: Riot text, Nevermove (E): 'Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer.' Range 850, cooldown 12/11.5/11/10.5/10. Demonic Ascension (R) is a flat 120s at all three ranks — the current text implies it is the cooldown to play around, but Nevermove comes back ten times as often. Remove Scurvy is 22/20/18/16/14 and cures crowd control.
audit.corrected: Nevermove named with its 850 range, 12s cooldown and return-wave root; Demonic Ascension's flat 120s stated so it is priced correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere in the full layer.
audit.why: Nevermove at 12s rank 1 is the punishable window; Demonic Ascension is 120s flat.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[9].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer says 'anti-heal stays core' without ever saying why, and nothing records that Ravenous Flock permanently raises Swain's maximum health, so resistances alone are the wrong response.
audit.why: Riot text, Ravenous Flock (P): 'Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.' That is both the sustain that Grievous Wounds must answer and the reason a raw armour/MR build loses value over the game.
